CAPACITYOBJFUNCTION.description: Objective Function from the Capacity Adequacy run

CAPACITYOPTION.description: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for capacity adequacy assessment: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%

INTERCONNECTORFLOWPENALTY.description: The penalty for non-zero interconnector flow

LASTCHANGED.description: Date and time the record was created or modified

LORCAPACITYOPTION.description: Generation Availability to be used in LOR run (either PASA or MARKET)

LORCONDITION.description: Lack of Reserve Condition (LOR) flag for the case indicates the most severe condition in the case  (3 = LOR3, 2 = LOR2, 1 = LOR1, 0 = No LOR)

LORDEMANDOPTION.description: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for LOR assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)

LORUIGFOPTION.description: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option

MAXSPARECAPACITYOPTION.description: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for assessment of Maximum Spare Capacity: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%

MAXSURPLUSRESERVEOPTION.description: Not populated as of 2005 End of Year Release; was the demand forecast used for assessment of Maximum surplus Reserve: 0 = no assessment, 1 = 10%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 90%

OUTAGELRCCAPACITYOPTION.description: Generation Availability to be used in Outage LRC run (either PASA or MARKET)

OUTAGELRCDEMANDOPTION.description: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for outage LRC assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)

OUTAGELRCUIGFOPTION.description: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option

PASAVERSION.description: Version of the PASA solver used to solve this case

RELIABILITYLRCCAPACITYOPTION.description: Generation Availability to be used in Reliability LRC run (either PASA or MARKET)

RELIABILITYLRCDEMANDOPTION.description: Specifies the Probability of Exceedence (POE) demand forecast for Reliability LRC assessment (0 if no assessment, 10 for 10%, 50 for 50%, 90 for 90%)

RELIABILITYLRCUIGFOPTION.description: UIGF POE forecast availability used for this option

RESERVECONDITION.description: Low Reserve Condition (LRC) flag for the case (1 - LRC in the case, 0 - No LRCs in the case) for capacity run

RUNTYPE.description: Discontinued in Dec 2005; was description of the constraints included in this run, being either System Normal and Planned Outage Constraints or System Normal Constraints Only

RUN_DATETIME.description: Date processing of the run begins.  Generated from the solution file caseid

RUN_NO.description: Unique run id.  Generated from the solution file caseid
